title: Pokémon HG/SS – Arceus Event Cutscene (Sinjoh Ruins)
description:
Arceus Event cutscene in Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver versions (at Sinjoh Ruins, after choosing one of the three Sinnoh legendaries on the Mystri Stage).
Probably the most WTF moment of the whole Pokémon franchise.

Recorded with DeSmuME 0.9.12 svn5428.
